title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy mandates, messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe neighbors’ and co-located individuals’ mask use and adjust their attitudes and wearing probability via descriptive and injunctive norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at locations increase compliance, with potential fines or denial of service for noncompliers.

interactions.name: messaging_campaign
interactions.description: Public health agency and media broadcast messages that shift risk perception and mask attitudes; misinformation may counteract.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People purchase masks from retailers subject to stock, price, and rationing policies; inventory affects ability to comply.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household-level norms and resource sharing influence individual attitudes and availability of masks.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Exogenous or simulated local disease risk alters individuals’ risk perception and mask attitudes, influencing adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days until overall adoption first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_policy
metrics.description: Average adoption rate in the period after mandate ends.

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask wearing rates stratified by location type (e.g., transit, retail, work).

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across subgroups (e.g., by income or ideology), measured via Gini or variance.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates before vs. during mandate, and during vs. after mandate.

metrics.name: stockouts_count
metrics.description: Number of retailer-days with zero mask stock.

metrics.name: enforcement_costs
metrics.description: Aggregate cost of enforcement activities and fines issued.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate remains within [0,1] for all time steps.

validation_criteria.name: no_negative_inventory
validation_criteria.description: Retailer and agent mask inventories never drop below zero.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Change in adoption rate over the final 14 days is below 1% absolute, indicating steady state.

validation_criteria.name: s_curve_plausibility
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory exhibits an S-shaped diffusion under baseline parameters (qualitative face validity).
